library_root.note: Each case's `instrument` is relative to this root, so the corpus runs wherever the library is installed: set KONTRA_TEST_LIBRARY, or lay the library out under the default.

note: Stereo, 32-bit float, 48 kHz, velocity 100, 2.0 s hold + 0.5 s tail, raw and unnormalised. Each case carries two reference WAVs captured from real Kontakt in two separate sessions; the spread between them is the case's threshold (with a floor of 0.5 dB level and 1.0 dB band RMS). `baseline` is where KONTRA stood against take `a` when the case was recorded: the threshold bounds movement from it, and `finding: true` (printed every run) marks a case that still disagrees with Kontakt by more than its threshold.

cases.name: Glory Days - 01. Trumpet 1 Multi
cases.instrument: Glory Days - Big Band Horns/Instruments/GDH - Glory Days - Big Band Horns 1.0/Multi Instruments/01. Trumpet 1/01. Trumpet 1 Multi.nki
cases.key_note: 70 - the median of the 52..89 run this instrument sounds on at velocity 100 (38 of its 128 covered keys sound, the top of the range being an octave-displaced layer).
cases.why: CAPSULE, 5 script slots and 409 PGS keys: the instrument that exposed the 64-key limit, so a regression there is silent on every other case.

cases.name: Fredonia Grand Organ
cases.instrument: Impact Soundworks - Fredonia Grand Organ/Instruments/Fredonia Grand Organ.nki
cases.key_note: 66 - the median of the 36..96 run it sounds on (all 61 covered keys sound).
cases.why: 3,927 prepared zones and no round robin: the most deterministic case in the corpus, so its threshold is the floor the others are judged against.

cases.name: Electric Mint
cases.instrument: Native Instruments Session Guitarist Electric Mint 1.1.0/Session Guitarist - Electric Mint Library/Instruments/Electric Mint.nki
cases.key_note: 68 - the median of the 60..76 run; Mint's lowest sounding key is 46, so 68 sits inside the guitar rather than at the edge of it.
cases.why: The instrument the whole project is measured against, and the only one with a Kontakt page reference committed beside it.

cases.name: Electric Mint (Melody)
cases.instrument: Native Instruments Session Guitarist Electric Mint 1.1.0/Session Guitarist - Electric Mint Library/Instruments/Electric Mint (Melody).nki
cases.key_note: 68 - the same 60..76 run as the main page, so the two pages are compared at the same pitch.
cases.why: The second page: eight ui_xy rows that were dead while the main instrument passed, and the widest round-robin spread in the corpus (its threshold is the honest measure of that).

cases.name: Haunted Strings 2
cases.instrument: #Non NICNT/Haunted Strings 2 v2.5.1 [Insanity Samples]/1. Haunted Strings 2 - Twisted Chamber Strings - Main Articulations.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - the median of the 24..96 run (every covered key sounds).
cases.why: Send slots plus a stored IR: the +5.9 dB dry bug lived here, from summing a send slot's stored dry on top of the dry path.

cases.name: Cherry Electric Bass
cases.instrument: #Non NICNT/Orange Tree Samples - Cherry Electric Bass/Cherry Electric Bass.nki
cases.key_note: 72 - the median of the 35..109 run; Kontakt sounds at 72 too (-7.9 dBFS), so the key is inside the instrument and not only inside KONTRA's map.
cases.why: Four script slots whose handlers exist only in Kontakt 8's private data; with that reader off the render falls 33 dB.

cases.name: Soundiron Harpsichord
cases.instrument: #Non NICNT/Soundiron - Harpsichord/Instruments/Harpsichord.nki
cases.key_note: 67 - the median of the 9..126 run (118 of 126 covered keys sound).
cases.why: %NOTE_DURATION and allow-group gating in one instrument: it was 26 dB loud and totally silent until the system array compiled.

cases.name: Glory Days - 05. Trombone 1 Multi (4-note chord)
cases.instrument: Glory Days - Big Band Horns/Instruments/GDH - Glory Days - Big Band Horns 1.0/Multi Instruments/05. Trombone 1/01. Trombone 1 Multi.nki
cases.key_note: 58 - the median of the 40..76 run; the chord is 58/62/65/70, all inside it.
cases.why: A four-note chord, where the level law has to sum rather than copy: on this instrument a chord sits only 0.4 dB above a single note, so a linear-sum bug reads as +12 dB.

cases.name: The Eminent Trombone
cases.library: Straight Ahead Samples - The Eminent Trombone
cases.instrument: Straight Ahead Samples - The Eminent Trombone/Instruments/The Eminent Trombone.nki
cases.key_note: 55 - the median of the 40..71 run (32 of 61 covered keys sound; the rest are keyswitch or unpitched groups).
cases.why: 43,338 zones with keyswitch-driven articulation groups: the dense end of zone preparation.

cases.name: Evolution EEB Rick - Bridge Only
cases.instrument: Evolution Electric Bass - Rick/EEB Rick - Bridge Only.nki
cases.key_note: 62 - the median of the only run KONTRA sounds on, 59..65, of 93 covered keys. A bass that sounds on six adjacent keys is itself a finding; the key is inside it rather than at 60 by habit.
cases.why: 32,620 zones in the bass range: it proves the corpus is not a key-60 test, and its old parity delta was -4.2 dB.

cases.name: Session Horns Pro - Keyswitch
cases.instrument: Session Horns Pro v1.5.0/Instruments/Session Horns Pro - Keyswitch.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - the median of the 42..79 run, which is the playable compass; the low run (2..39) is the articulation switches and the top run (88..127) is not the instrument.
cases.why: An articulation that needs a keyswitch before it sounds, so the note alone is not the whole input.

cases.name: Spitfire Studio Brass - Horns a4 Decorative
cases.instrument: Spitfire_Studio_Brass/Instruments/_Advanced_/Extended techniques/b - Horns a4 - Decorative techniques.nki
cases.key_note: 57 - the median of the 37..77 run (all 41 covered keys sound).
cases.why: A genuinely quiet instrument (Kontakt peaks at 0.0035, -49 dBFS): level bugs that hide above -20 dBFS are visible here.

cases.name: Studio Drummer - Stadium Kit Full
cases.instrument: Studio Drummer 1.4.1 [Native Instruments]/Instruments/Stadium Kit - Full.nki
cases.key_note: 54 - the median of the 27..81 run: a drum slot in the middle of the map, not a pitched note.
cases.why: Drums: key-mapped rather than pitched, so the note's pitch is an identity and not a resampling ratio.

cases.name: Vintage Organs - C3 Jazz
cases.instrument: Vintage Organs Library/Instruments/2 - Jazz/C3 Jazz.nki
cases.key_note: 66 - the median of the 36..96 run (every covered key sounds).
cases.why: A second organ product, so Fredonia is not the only organ and an organ-wide law cannot pass on one instrument.

cases.name: Unity - Nostalgic Synth
cases.instrument: Unity - Nostalgic Synth 1.2.1 [Ava Music Group]/Instruments/UNITY - Nostalgic Synth.nki
cases.key_note: 72 - the median of the 36..108 run (every covered key sounds).

cases.name: AudioBro LASS - Aleatoric Sustained Cellos
cases.instrument: AudioBro LASS Bundles/Instruments/Aleatoric (FX)/Aleatoric Sustained Cellos.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - KONTRA refuses the instrument, so the key only names the note a reference would play if decryption ever lands.
cases.why: Both engines refuse it (the .nicnt carries no JDX/HU key material, the presets are NI-encrypted): pins the content exclusion, and flips to a positive case only if decryption ever lands.

cases.name: Garritan - Flute 1
cases.instrument: Garritan - Jazz & Big Band/Instruments/01 Saxes and Woodwinds/Flutes/Flute 1.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - KONTRA refuses it as legacy XML; 60 is the flute's written middle register and the note Kontakt's reference plays.
cases.why: KONTRA refuses it as a legacy XML preset while Kontakt loads it and it sounds (peak 0.056): the known asymmetry, pinned so it cannot be quietly forgotten.
cases.refusal_reason: legacy XML instruments are not read

cases.name: Evolve R2 - Piano Glissandos 02
cases.instrument: Evolve R2 Library/Instruments/3 Stings and Transitions/Uncaged Piano/Piano Glissandos 02.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - KONTRA refuses it on modulator category 3; the reference documents that Kontakt is silent here too.
cases.why: KONTRA refuses it on modulator category 3; Kontakt loads it and is silent on this note too, so the reference documents a legitimate silence rather than a missing feature.

cases.name: Spitfire Glass and Steel - Alien Distortions MW Cool Filter
cases.library: #Non NICNT / Spitfire Glass and Steel library
cases.instrument: #Non NICNT/Spitfire Glass and Steel library/Instruments/Cinematic Rhythms/Alien Distortions MW Cool Filter.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - KONTRA translates 0 zones, so no key can sound; 60 is the census note and the note the Kontakt reference plays.
cases.why: One of the 243 #Non NICNT instruments with zero playable zones: silent for a structural reason, so the corpus records that KONTRA loads it and makes no sound rather than crashing.
cases.gap: KONTRA translates 0 zones from this .nki and renders silence; Kontakt plays it at -9.8 dBFS, so the zones are reachable some way KONTRA does not read.

cases.name: Scene - Lotus
cases.instrument: Scene - Lotus [Native Instruments]/Instruments/Scene - Lotus.nki
cases.key_note: 60 - the median of the 24..84 run; KONTRA is silent on all of it and Kontakt sounds, which is the gap this case records.
cases.why: 39,997,154 of the corpus's 40M script-fault events, and silent: the pathological script case, where a regression shows up as a crash or as sound that never existed.
cases.gap: Kontakt plays it (-27.6 dBFS) through a script that faults 39,997,154 times in KONTRA; KONTRA's render is silent.
